files.observed: prepare_target calculates the unit fingerprint and returns Job::new_fresh() immediately when FingerprintComparison is Fresh. Source::verify is reached only after a dirty_reason exists, immediately before Cargo prepares work for a rebuild.
The Source trait describes verify as an optional source verification hook intended to run just before a crate is compiled.
DirectorySource::verify iterates cksum.files from .cargo-checksum.json and hashes those listed paths; it does not enumerate the package tree or reject an extra unlisted file in this function.

slice.result: At the pinned revision, DirectorySource checksum verification is guaranteed on the dirty/rebuild path before the build work is prepared, but it is not guaranteed on the fresh-unit early-return path because prepare_target returns before Source::verify. The adjacent verification path itself also does not enumerate/reject extra unlisted package files. Therefore the stronger claim that every directory-source package use is preceded by a complete package-tree integrity check is falsified for this call path.
